title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at FourQuarters Recruitment (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Data Analyst | Melbourne CBD | Permanent Position About the Company The client is a Melbourne CBD-based financial organisation looking to expand their Data Team. They are keen to improve the data arm of the business and eventually move towards using more advanced Analytics/Data Science tools. About the Role The Data Analyst will be required to work within the Data team to take control of and drive forward an existing Forecasting Model. They are looking for a Data Analyst who understands the levers behind financial products. Required Experience and Knowledge: Experience with R/Python, SQL and Excel Experience with forecast modelling, risk/credit and statistical modelling Previous experience within a Financial Organisation would be preferrable How to Apply Click APPLY or contact Zale Stobbs, Big Data, BI & Data Analytics Consultant on (03) 9982 8489 for a confidential discussion.
